title: [ORION-QG QG-17] Sharpness attack on the R6I support1 objective phase: exact weighted cap1 vs frozen support2 witnesses
body:
Parent phase theorem: #811 / PR #813 / protected receipt commit `406886f55aaaa08a4b310d336e3c98a87371e97e`
Parent support1 theorem: #807 / PR #809
Frozen adversarial generator: canonical QG-9 V5 #795 / PR #796

## Status

**PROSPECTIVE PHASE-SHARPNESS EXPERIMENT — exact support2 witness vs exact weighted cap1, no unrestricted weighted DP required.**

QG-16 proves support1 for all n inside a four-facet objective cone but deliberately leaves global sharpness OPEN. QG-17 attacks that boundary using the exact V5 obstruction-derived n=2 candidate generator already frozen before its unit-objective outcome.

## Key implication

For any objective theta, if a verified feasible support2 configuration has cost `C2(theta)` and the exact support<=1 optimum has cost `C_cap1(theta)`, then

`C_DP(theta) <= C2(theta) < C_cap1(theta)`

is already sufficient to prove that support1 is **not** globally sufficient at theta. No unrestricted weighted DP call is needed.

## Frozen objectives

Reuse QG-16's pre-registered outside controls, in this order:

1. `O_tag_out=(t_nc,t_c,t_tag,t_r)=(4,2,5/2,1)`;
2. `O_restore_out=(4,2,2,5/4)`;
3. `O_nc_out=(3/2,3/2,1,1)`.

Also compute O0=(4,2,2,1) only as a negative/binding control; QG-16 already proves cap1 exact there.

All arithmetic is exact `Fraction`.

## Candidate generator — imported frozen V5 order

Use **without modification** the V5 generator from `qg9_support2_tightness.py`:
- 36 accepted support2 method-obstruction types;
- 1,296 concrete unique blocks;
- 4,104 compatible SELF/CROSS block pairs;
- template families in exact frozen order:
  `IDENTITY_RESTORE`, `ONE_DEFECT_A`, `ONE_DEFECT_B`, `MATCHED_DEFECT`;
- candidate enumeration order unchanged.

QG-17 may reprice these candidates but may not add new targets/templates after outcomes.

## Feasible support2 witness cost

For each V5 candidate `(block A, block B, targets A/B)`:
- use the candidate's exact frame generators and the shared `(S0,S1)` carried by its compatible block group;
- verify R6I acceptance exactly;
- minimize central choice separately for each block under `(t_c,t_nc)`;
- minimize the frozen relative-B target permutation for block B;
- compute exact weighted Restore and Tag terms.

This gives a verified feasible `C2(theta)`; it need not be globally cap2-optimal for a strict gap to be decisive.

## Exact weighted cap1 referee

Enumerate the exact 12 ordered support1 anticommuting frame pairs per block. For each A/B pair:
- frame extra is zero (all three local frame weights are one);
- minimize A Restore over its frozen target order;
- minimize B Restore over all 6 relative target permutations;
- enumerate all shared Tag strings and retain equal nonzero distinct labels;
- minimize `t_r*Restore + t_tag*TagSupport` exactly.

Cache static Tag-support minima by frame-pair pair and target Restore minima by target triple. A second independent implementation must reconstruct the same cap1 value.

## Prospective selection / outputs

For each objective independently, scan the entire frozen V5 order and record the **first** strict witness with `C2<C_cap1`; continue scanning to obtain:
- strict-witness count;
- maximum gap `C_cap1-C2`;
- first and maximum-gap witnesses;
- family/pair-kind histogram.

O0 is required to have zero strict witnesses; otherwise parent binding fails.

## Affine witness certificate

For every selected support2 witness and its selected cap1 optimum, serialize their integer resource vectors:

`r2=(U_c_extra,U_nc_extra,TagSupport,RestoreSupport)`
`r1=(0,0,TagSupport_cap1,RestoreSupport_cap1)`.

Then the exact difference is

`Delta(theta)=(r2-r1)·(t_c,t_nc,t_tag,t_r)`.

Report the zero hyperplane and evaluate it at O0 and the selected outside point. If the hyperplane is proportional to a QG-16 facet, record `FACET_SHARPNESS_WITNESS`; otherwise record a new true-phase boundary candidate.

No claim that a finite witness proves the entire global boundary; it proves non-support1 at the witnessed objective and can prove local sharpness of a specific facet only when the affine zero set matches it.

## Independent generic ORION

Rebuild phase-free Pauli algebra, all 12 cap1 frame pairs, weighted cap1 referee, support2 witness resource vector and strict inequality independently. It need not regenerate all 211,248 candidates to verify a positive witness; it must reconstruct each selected witness from serialized raw frames/Tag/targets.

## Native ORION-Q

Responsibilities:
- `SUPPORT2_PHASE_WITNESS`
- `NO_WITNESS_ON_FROZEN_V5_DOMAIN`
- `PARENT_BINDING_GAP`
- `GENERIC_DISAGREEMENT`

It must keep `GLOBAL_PHASE_BOUNDARY_COMPLETE=false` unless a separate theorem closes it.

## Positive terminals

- `QG17_SUPPORT2_PHASE_WITNESS_FOUND_AT_FROZEN_OUTSIDE_OBJECTIVE`
- stronger annotation `QG17_QG16_FACET_LOCALLY_SHARP_BY_AFFINE_WITNESS` when exact hyperplane proportionality holds.

Honest negative: `QG17_NO_SUPPORT2_WITNESS_IN_FROZEN_V5_DOMAIN`.

## Claim boundary

No novelty credit for parametric optimization/Pareto methods. A positive establishes an exact compiler normal-form phase transition at a frozen structural objective; no physical quantum-advantage claim follows.
